title: Evaluation of the canonical chart cohomology comparison
statement: For morphisms f:X→S, g:B→S, a:T→B and g′:T→S with g′=a≫g, an abelian étale sheaf F on X, n≥0, an étale B-scheme V, an étale T-scheme U, and a specified pullback square U→V over a, let z be a raw degree-n class for the sheaf pulled to T×_B(X×_S B), evaluated at V. The canonical chart cohomology comparison applied to the raw evaluation of z equals precomposition by the single-functor image of the specified free-representable pullback isomorphism followed by the canonical chart raw-adjunction comparison of z.

source.place: Second proof, evaluation of the canonical comparison square; Tag 03Q8 for raw evaluation.

proof.text: Unfold cartesianChartCohomologyIso, which is the inverse raw-evaluation comparison followed by the chart raw-adjunction comparison and the free-source transport. Evaluate the two composed isomorphisms, cancel raw evaluation with its inverse by Iso.hom_inv_id_apply, and evaluate the Yoneda source isomorphism as precomposition. The remaining expression is definitionally the displayed raw-adjunction comparison. This is the existing proved chartCohomologyIso_eval calculation and also covers n=0 and empty test objects.

proof_origin.place: Attach the existing proved chartCohomologyIso_eval; its proof unfolds the specified isomorphisms and cancels inverse evaluation.

lean.statement:
theorem chartCohomologyIso_eval {S X B T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : B ⟶ S) (a : T ⟶ B) (g' : T ⟶ S) (w : g' = a ≫ g)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (n : ℕ)
    (V : B.Etale) (U : T.Etale) (r : U.left ⟶ V.left)
    (hr : IsPullback r U.hom V.hom a)
    (z : (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf
      (pullback.snd a (pullback.snd f g) ≫ pullback.snd f g) n
      (((pullback.snd a (pullback.snd f g))^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj
        (((pullback.fst f g)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F))).obj (op V)) :
    (cartesianChartCohomologyIso f g a g' w F n V U r hr).hom
      (rawRestrictedCohomologyComparison _ n _ V z) =
    (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map
        (abelianFreeRepresentablePullbackSquareIso a V U r hr).hom ≫
      (cartesianChartRawAdjunctionIso f g a g' w F n V).hom z
